name: backflow-protocol
description: BackFlow - Contract-enforced revenue sharing for earners and backers on Monad

scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:engine && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:api && npm run test:milestone
scripts.test:contracts: export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.foundry/bin" && cd contracts && forge test -vvv
scripts.build:packages: npx -w @backflow/types tsc && npx -w @backflow/validation tsc && npx -w @backflow/financial-engine tsc
scripts.build:all: npx -w @backflow/types tsc && npx -w @backflow/validation tsc && npx -w @backflow/financial-engine tsc && npx -w @backflow/api tsc && npx -w @backflow/web next build
